data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2024 is a first year of underwriting; there is no prior year comparative claims outstanding balance. Gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2024 are reported at 10.062 million (USD). No prior year reserve movement (strengthening or release) is recorded because there are no prior-year reserves to reestimate. The report notes a record Atlantic hurricane season in 2024 but states upstream energy experienced minimal losses, and the Syndicate made allowances for a potential 'Dali' loss on the International Group.
raw_causal_phrases: allowances have been made for the potential Dali loss on the International Group

Although 2024 had a record-breaking Atlantic Hurricane season and the second costliest on record, the upstream energy account experienced minimal losses due to the larger storms missing the oil patch and instead hitting Florida.
Reserve adequacy is monitored through quarterly review by the Syndicate actuary, the Reserving Committee and the Audit Committee.
data.data_quality_notes: This is the Syndicate's first underwriting year, so no opening (1 Jan) gross claims outstanding prior-year comparative is available. No movement in prior year reserves is present. Figures in the report are presented in $000; reported monetary fields above are converted to millions (USD). There are minor inconsistencies in gross written premium totals within the report (28,278 vs 28,280/28,680 $000 in different tables); the divisional premium split was summed to 28.278 million USD for consistency with the P&L/KPI line.
